automations.name: Night path light
automations.why: Light the way so nobody walks to the door in the dark.
automations.label: Night path

automations.name: Visual doorbell
automations.why: Flash the lights for people who cannot hear the bell.
automations.label: Doorbell!

automations.name: Package porch light
automations.why: Make a delivered package easy to see and hard to take unnoticed.
automations.label: Package

ask.question: Is a delivered package, box or parcel visible at the door?
ask.yes: a package, parcel or shipping box is at the door
ask.no: no package: only people, signs, food, vehicles or an empty porch

automations.name: Night vehicle floodlight
automations.why: Light up the driveway when a car arrives at night.
automations.label: Car arriving

ask.question: Is a car, truck or other vehicle visible in the driveway?
ask.yes: a car, truck, van or other vehicle is in the driveway
ask.no: no vehicle: only people, packages, animals or an empty driveway
